name: Temporary Residence and Work Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a written job offer from a Montenegrin employer for a specific workplace, plus proof of means of subsistence, accommodation, health insurance, a travel document/ID valid at least 3 months beyond the permit period, and proof of educational/professional qualifications. Authorities check criminal history and run a security clearance ex officio. Processing deadline is 15 days. Fees: EUR 60 (permit) + EUR 5 (permit form) + EUR 2 (request).
requirements.fix_path: Secure a written job offer from a Montenegrin employer, then apply to the Ministry of the Interior.

outcome.duration_length: standard temporary residence period of 1 year, renewable

sources.title: Portal of the Public Administration of Montenegro (psc.gov.me), Ministry of the Interior section -- official temporary residence and work permit requirements: employer job offer, standard supporting documents, ex officio criminal/security checks, 15-day processing deadline, and fee schedule

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Montenegro). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- direct government-portal sourcing, tier 1. GAP, DISCLOSED NOT INVENTED: the source did not specify a labor-market test or local-hiring-priority quota (unlike Kazakhstan, Kenya, or Lebanon's kafala-adjacent systems built elsewhere in this dataset) -- this may reflect a genuinely lighter-touch system as an EU-candidate country harmonizing with EU labor-mobility norms, or simply a gap in the page reviewed; not asserted either way. family_can_join/family_can_work set false at this route's level since Montenegro handles dependents through a distinct Family Reunification permit category (see me_family_reunification.json), not as an automatic feature of the work permit itself.
